name: codex-advisor
description: Autonomous primary work with eleven tier-named native entries (explorer, worker, advisor at light, standard, and senior), a routing profile, a first-round pool and senior gate, an escalation ladder, and Advisor decision and acceptance packets.

interface.shortDescription: Implement or delegate with tier-named explorer, worker, and advisor entries and a routing profile.
interface.longDescription: Any primary can implement, delegate, or combine both within user goals and resources. Eleven native entries are named by role and tier: explorer, worker, and advisor at light, standard, and senior. Dials live in one routing profile. Light and standard form the first-round pool; senior is reached only through the senior gate. Failed acceptance follows the escalation ladder. Advisor entries answer a decision packet or an acceptance packet. Explicit Architect mode delegates every implementation edit for any primary. Primary settings remain user-owned; missing required evidence leaves affected acceptance pending.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-advisor:orchestration to implement and verify this feature.
Choose direct work or suitable delegates within my scope and resources, preserving my primary model and reasoning effort.
